I replied to Hollis in the thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

It comes from #central-team, which Hollis is in. On 9 June Pree (Priyanka Sundaram) posted that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who showed up at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note.
